Name: PoshAcme
Description: Posh-ACME core settings, read by Install-PoshAcme.ps1, Test-PoshAcmePrerequisites.ps1 and the role scripts from this folder (with Get-ApplicationSettings). A server that needs other values gets PoshAcme.<COMPUTERNAME>.json next to this file, listing only what differs. Bump Version whenever any file of the core changes; SetupApplications.ps1 compares it with the copy on each server.

Notes.RunAs: Account the tasks run as; it owns the saved (encrypted) DNS plugin credentials.
Notes.Manager: Defaults of Show-PoshAcmeCertificateManagement.ps1: DNS plugin preselected for new certificates, seconds to wait for DNS, certificate key (2048 = RSA, needed by Exchange), account key.
Notes.Domain: Main domain of this server's Posh-ACME order. Empty = this computer's FQDN.
